summary: Top KingWin Ltd filed a 6-K attaching a notice of extraordinary general meeting and proxy card. The EGM proposes increasing authorized share capital from US$31.25M to US$625M by creating additional Class A and Class B ordinary shares, and varying Class B share rights to increase votes per share from 40 to 200, remove conversion upon transfer. No tender offer, acquisition, or activist campaign is disclosed. The filing is a routine corporate governance proposal to amend the memorandum and articles. Watch for shareholder vote outcome.
